_about: Hand labels for the steps the transcript reader produced on three real English auto-caption transcripts (fetched 2026-10-16 with the opt-in captions adapter). ONLY video id, the second a unit starts at and the label are stored: no caption text (derived YouTube data, 30-day rule). 'correct' lists the catalog features that would be an acceptable tag for what the speaker is doing at that moment; [] means 'not a rigging step' (intro, outro, chatter, testing, advice), so any tag there is a false step. One labeller (the assistant that wrote the reader), so this measures progress, not accuracy; a second labeller is still needed. The scoring test skips when the local caption cache is absent.
labelled_on: 2026-10-16 (third pass: 13 more moments, labelled AFTER seeing the reader output, so biased toward agreement)
